question: Order ORD-023 was split into two shipments. Give me the status of each and explain why it was split.
agent_answer:
Here's the full picture for **ORD-023** (urgent order to Mandarin Oriental, placed 2026-02-10):

---

## Shipment Status

| Shipment | Carrier | Type | Status | ETA |
|----------|---------|------|--------|-----|
| **SHP-017** | SCG Cold Chain | Refrigerated | In transit | 2026-02-13 17:00 |

Both were dispatched simultaneously on 2026-02-12 08:00 from Bangkok Central Warehouse. No exceptions or delays flagged on either.

---

## Why It Was Split

The order contains two products with incompatible storage requirements (WMS):

- **PROD-001 — Nam Doc Mai Mango Box 5kg** → `storage_type: refrigerated`, shelf life 7 days → **must** travel via cold chain (SHP-017, SCG Cold Chain)
- **PROD-006 — Dried Mango Slices 500g** → `storage_type: ambient`, shelf life 180 days → can travel via standard ground carrier (SHP-018, Kerry Express)

This is correct procedure: shipping refrigerated goods on a ground truck would risk spoilage. The split also optimizes cost — ground freight (Kerry) at 15 THB/kg vs. cold chain (SCG) at 25 THB/kg, so only the perishable items pay the cold chain premium.

Both shipments are on track to arrive before the required date of **2026-02-15**.
